p, k = map(int, input().split())
MODULUS = 1000000007

def compute_power(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    b = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * b) % mod
        b = (b * b) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

        j = i

            j = (j * k) % p
            d += 1
            if visited_array[j]:

        if compute_power(k, d, p) == 1:
            result = (result * p) % MODULUS
    print(result)
